verdict.rationale: Vercel's own docs let users choose the region of a Vercel Blob store, and Function compute regions can be set per project or per function. That gives real control over where object data lives and is processed. However, the evidence shows no platform-wide data-residency commitment covering other stored data such as logs, account or project metadata, or databases, which run through third-party Marketplace providers. missing for 10: platform-wide data residency guarantee, residency controls for logs/metadata and databases, documented list of available storage regions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Each store lives in one region that you choose, and Vercel's CDN caches your files close to your users.
You can override regions for individual functions using the functions property in your project configuration.
